title: Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization via Zeroth-Order Residual Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2610.13871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many optimization problems provide direct access to only part of the gradient, while the remaining component must be inferred from function evaluations. This structure arises in performative prediction, performative reinforcement learning, and bilevel optimization with a black-box lower level. We introduce Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization (PISO), which combines the available gradient component with a running estimate of the residual. By centring each zeroth-order observation on this estimate, PISO makes the variance due to random probing depend on the tracking error rather than the residual's magnitude. This yields a randomized sketch iteration with an explicit contraction mechanism and a principled interpretation of momentum. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish convergence guarantees that depend on the residual's variation and initial magnitude, without requiring a uniform bound on the unavailable gradient component.

translated_title: 基于零阶残差追踪的部分信息随机优化
translated_abstract: 许多优化问题只能直接获取梯度的一部分，而剩余的分量必须通过函数值评估来推断。这种结构出现在执行性预测、执行性强化学习以及带有黑盒下层问题的双层优化中。我们提出了部分信息随机优化，它将可获得的梯度分量与残差的运行估计相结合。通过将每次零阶观测以该估计为中心，PISO使得由随机探测引起的方差取决于追踪误差而非残差的幅值。这产生了一种具有显式收缩机制的随机化草图迭代，以及对动量的原理性解释。对于光滑非凸目标，我们建立了依赖于残差变化量和初始幅值的收敛保证，而无需对不可获取的梯度分量施加一致界。
tldr: 提出了PISO方法，将可获取的梯度分量与残差的运行估计相结合进行零阶残差追踪，使随机探测产生的方差取决于追踪误差而非残差幅值，从而在光滑非凸目标上建立了无需对不可获取梯度分量施加一致界的收敛保证。
